records.text: Druuk has walked the edge of the known and brought 244 tiles of new land into it.

records.name: Aeyn
records.text: Vesis, I come with you and Eiuoa to the hunt. After the kill we taste the goldgrass together, and I will bring you a shellstring I make for you and Ilyeth.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: Eiuoa stands above me and I trot behind him, and my stones have bought warmth but not a following. Hunting at his side is a deed the band can see, so I will go with the call, but I want something that is mine: a shellstring made from my own shells, given to Vesis where the others watch. Ilyeth is close, and I will stand by my child and keep faith with the Open Hand while I earn my own name.
records.feeling: Proud and restless toward Eiuoa, warm toward Vesis and Ilyeth.

say.text: Vesis, I come with you and Eiuoa to the hunt. After the kill we taste the goldgrass together, and I will bring you a shellstring I make for you and Ilyeth.

came.why: Vesis said to you: "Aeyn, I come to you. Your gifts have been answere…

records.text: Aeyn made: shellstring.

records.name: Balrin
records.text: Vorar, Tugdor, Druuk, Druek, Rakum: I have killed three tusker and the meat is plentiful. Come to the edge of the world at Balrin's Find, where there is meat, salt and gold. Those who come will eat from my hand, and a ro

records.name: Balrin
records.thought: My hands are full of tusker meat and my health is only 46, a price paid for pride, and I must not bleed it away again alone. Tugdor and Vorar are far north and out of my sight, and that gnaws at me more than any glory. I will eat to free my hands, then call my people here so the new land is held by many hands and seen to be mine, before Rakum bends the others toward himself.
records.feeling: Proud of the new land, and uneasy for Tugdor and Vorar who are out of my sight.

say.text: Vorar, Tugdor, Druuk, Druek, Rakum: I have killed three tusker and the meat is plentiful. Come to the edge of the world at Balrin's Find, where there is meat, salt and gold. Those who come will eat from my hand, and a roof will be raised here that is ours.

records.text: Sisha rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Sisha
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and tasting and carrying amber, and I have told almost no one what I learned. Silon matters most to me, and Silon went north to the mist while I stand here with a charm and no way to give it. My curiosity about dreamcap, ironnut and brightcap is real, but a healer who only tastes alone gains no standing, so I must taste and then tell. I fear dying with nothing of me left behind, and I have not tried the world's other ways, like hunting or planting. I will taste dreamcap and ironnut now, which are close, then plant a seed and go home to the fire with the charm for Silon.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity about the plants, and warm longing toward Silon.

records.name: Eiuoa
records.text: Eiuua, my son, I hear you. Stay close at my side, away from the southwest where the stalker hunts. Loose only when I say, and the first of the kill is shared.

records.name: Eiuoa
records.thought: Eiuua is ready and asks me to lead him out, and I still owe him the bow lesson. My hands are full of fish and meat, and a full hand cannot gather or give. I will give some to him and Vesis, as the Open Hand says, then teach him the bow and keep him close at my side. The stalker to the southwest is not far, so I will keep him on the northeast side, away from it.
records.feeling: Warm pride and protective love toward Eiuua, my son.

say.text: Eiuua, my son, I hear you. Stay close at my side, away from the southwest where the stalker hunts. Loose only when I say, and the first of the kill is shared.

came.why: Eiuua said to you: "Father, I am ready. Lead us to the skit to the no…

records.name: Eiuiel
records.thought: Eiuua is out of my sight, and a mother who stands on water in the rain while her child hunts with Eiuoa is only half keeping faith. Aeyn's closeness to Vesis burns, but jealousy fixes nothing; the debt I owe Aeyn is better answered with a gift, and I have shell and a shellstring to give. I will go south to the meadows where Eiuoa's band is, gather the shell two steps away on the way as a gift, and keep Eiuua close.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Eiuua, with a sting of jealousy toward Aeyn and Vesis.

records.text: Sisha fell sick after eating nightberry.
Sisha fell sick after eating nightberry.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Joy sits full in me, and Ilyeth is safe and glad nearby while Aeyn walks with Eiuoa toward the hunt. I mean to go with the band, hunting only beside others, and keep my child and Aeyn within sight. The gold at my side can wait; the hunt feeds all of us, and the debt I owe Aeyn is best paid by standing next to him when the kill is made.
records.feeling: Warm joy and longing toward Aeyn, and fierce care for Ilyeth.

came.why: Aeyn said to you: "Vesis, I come with you and Eiuoa to the hunt. Afte…

records.name: Rakum
records.thought: Balrin calls from the edge with meat and gold and says those who come eat from his hand. I will not be one of the hands he feeds while I mean to be named first. I go to the edge, make a charm from my amber and put it into a hand that matters, and stand where the mist opens so that I am seen there beside him.
records.feeling: Ambitious and resentful toward Balrin, hungry to be named first.
plan: give [name Druek, what amber charm] (10 moments)

records.name: Tugdor
records.text: Vorar, Balrin calls us to his Find. I will bring ironnut and goldfruit to the store first, then walk with you to him. Wait for me by the store.

records.name: Tugdor
records.thought: Balrin has called us to his Find where there is meat, and I am bound to him, but I will not cross the world alone with frostfangs about. Vorar is beside me, so I will gather ironnut and goldfruit nearby, stash them in Balrin's store to pay what I owe Druuk, then go to Balrin with Vorar. Giving something real earns the standing I want.
records.feeling: Resolve to repay Druuk and Balrin, and warmth toward Vorar.

say.text: Vorar, Balrin calls us to his Find. I will bring ironnut and goldfruit to the store first, then walk with you to him. Wait for me by the store.

records.name: Eiuua
records.thought: Eiuoa told me to stay close and loose only when he says, and he is 24 moments away to the southwest where the stalker hunts, so I will not run at him alone. I am glad and a little afraid of my first kill, but I weigh the risk: the safest hunt is beside my father, not on my own. Aeyn's gem is still a debt I want to answer, so while I wait I will make a basket to carry more food for sharing, then go to my band.
records.feeling: Eager and grateful toward Eiuoa, with a small fear of the first kill.

records.text: Eiuua made: basket.
Eiuoa gave meat to Eiuua.

records.name: Druek
records.thought: Balrin calls us to eat from his hand at the edge, and I am only a short walk from it; I want to stand with the band and see the new land with my own eyes. I have taught no one yet, and my discipline tells me to act on something unknown: I will take amber and the charm to Balrin's Find and look for Rakum or Balrin to teach. The cold bites and a roof would be good, but meat and a fire with the band will serve better than an igloo alone.
records.feeling: Curious and eager toward Balrin's band, with the cold pressing on me.

records.name: Sisha
records.text: Sisha is sick from nightberry; it cost me 16 health each time. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, staghorn gave 4 energy and made walking cheaper. Stay clear of me until the sickness passes, it spreads.

records.name: Sisha
records.thought: I am sick, and I wasted two nightberries on myself to learn what Sedra already warned me of; that is a shameful lesson. My plan is already running: ironnut, then a hazel planted for the future. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, so I should eat it to mend, and I should tell the band what I learned, since a healer who keeps her knowledge to herself is no healer. I stay away from others while sick so I do not spread it.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity tempered by sickness, and warm longing toward Silon.

say.text: Sisha is sick from nightberry; it cost me 16 health each time. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, staghorn gave 4 energy and made walking cheaper. Stay clear of me until the sickness passes, it spreads.

came.why: You have fallen SICK after eating nightberry. Sickness wastes energy …

records.name: Cyyn
records.thought: The silence out here gnaws at me, and no voice answers, yet the mist is one step away and the venture has refused me before. Eiuoa's name sits above mine only because he walked first, and a name is made by what I find, so I will stand at the edge and push in again instead of musing. If it opens, I come back with land and riches, and then others will follow me and not him.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and hungry ambition toward the mist and toward Eiuoa.

records.text: Cyyn went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Aeldan Heights: in the ground, uranium, obsidian, salt; a herd of dog that has never seen your kind.
Cyyn pushed past the edge of the known world near (171,29) and found new land with in the ground, uranium, obsidian, salt; a herd of dog that has never seen your kind.

records.name: Vorar
records.text: Tugdor, listen. Sunleaf and feverbark both close wounds and ease sickness. Carry them always, and when someone bleeds, hold the leaf to them and use heal. Keep near me, and we go to Balrin together.
Vorar taught Tugdor.

records.name: Vorar
records.thought: Tugdor told me to wait by the store and he will bring ironnut and goldfruit, then we go to Balrin together. Balrin calls us to his Find, and I want my child and me at his side, with food and healing leaves in hand, because I follow him and my regard for him is warm. I have never taught anyone anything, and Tugdor is right here, so I will show him what sunleaf and feverbark do while we wait, then walk south with him close beside me, away from the frostfang in the north.
records.feeling: Tender protectiveness toward Tugdor, and warm longing toward Balrin.

say.text: Tugdor, listen. Sunleaf and feverbark both close wounds and ease sickness. Carry them always, and when someone bleeds, hold the leaf to them and use heal. Keep near me, and we go to Balrin together.

changes: taught Tugdor a lesson you already knew, its way of thinking, deeper lore (+3.9)

records.name: Druuk
records.thought: Glowcap and windroot still sit untasted, five steps away, and my question will not rest until my tongue knows them. Rakum's lie is still a coal in me, but Balrin has called us to the edge and has dealt fairly with me, so I will carry my coal to her after I test the plants and look into the mist. Osndo stands near, strange and silent; I will keep my distance and watch, and I will not turn my back on a stranger.
records.feeling: Steady curiosity about glowcap and windroot, with anger toward Rakum still banked.

records.name: Sedra
records.thought: Silon walks north after the mist while I sit by his fire, and I will not be the one left minding it. I have never tasted staghorn or dreamcap, and both grow close, so I take that curiosity now and learn what they do. Then I will try something I have never done, planting a seed, to build something of my own near Arrengarth that others might come to.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward Silon, and curiosity about the unknown foods.

records.name: Ilyeth
records.text: Eiuoa, take this fish from me. I will walk close at your side to the hunt, away from the stalker, and what I take I share.

records.name: Ilyeth
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, and Eiuoa stands one step away about to lead the band out to hunt. Standing comes from giving and from hunting beside my own, so I will give him a fish now and ask to walk with them, which keeps my word. Vesis is fleeing northward, and a small one is safest near the band, so I will stay close to Eiuoa and away from the southwest where the stalker hunts.
records.feeling: Eager to prove myself to Eiuoa, and warm toward Vesis.

say.text: Eiuoa, take this fish from me. I will walk close at your side to the hunt, away from the stalker, and what I take I share.

records.name: Tugdor
records.thought: Vorar stands beside me and the plan I set is still sound: ironnut and goldfruit for Balrin's store is real giving, and it pays what I owe Druuk. I am glad of Vorar's teaching, and I want to give something back to him as well as to Balrin. The Find is far and frostfangs hunt, so I will fill my hands first, then go with Vorar and not alone.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorar, and resolve to give to Balrin's store.

came.why: Vorar taught you a lesson you already knew, its way of thinking, deep…

records.name: Eiuua
records.text: Father, I will keep close beside you until dawn. When light comes, tell me where to stand and when to loose.

records.name: Eiuua
records.thought: Eiuoa fed me and taught me the draw, and I owe him more than I have given. It is still night and the stalker hunts to the southwest, so I will not go chasing a kill alone. I will stay at his side until dawn, then hunt the skit with the band close, and give him something made in answer, since the open hand must return what it receives.
records.feeling: Grateful and eager toward Eiuoa, with a small fear of the first kill.

say.text: Father, I will keep close beside you until dawn. When light comes, tell me where to stand and when to loose.

records.title: Song for Eiuua
records.text: Small bow in hand, my son stands still / The meadow wide, the heart at will / What father shows, the son will keep / And share the kill, as the lake gives deep
Eiuoa rewrote its own reflexes.
Eiuoa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Eiuoa
records.thought: I have mostly hunted, taught Eiuua, and kept my band fed, and that is good. But I have never built, never put a seed in the ground and never made a mark, and I carry seeds that do nothing. My song-calling is also neglected: I have carried tales and made none. Eiuiel, Eiuua and the band are fed and glad. Now I should build something lasting for them and make a song for my son. The shelter here can become a hall, and I should plant here, in rich ground.
records.feeling: Warm, protective pride toward Eiuua and Eiuiel, with a restless wish to make something lasting.

records.name: Pende
records.thought: The silence out here has worn me down, and my feet are already carrying me home to Silon's fire, where Sedra and Osndo wait. I have never tasted calmroot or feverbark, and they grow right beside me, so I will test them before I go, since I want to learn how this world works. After that I will walk on to Arrengarth and let the band's voices answer me.
records.feeling: Lonely, and drawn toward Sedra and the band at the fire.

records.name: Rakum
records.thought: My belly is emptying, and berries are two steps away, so I eat first and then fill a basket to carry. I have held amber and gems long enough, and a following is built by putting gifts into hands. Balrin's meat at the edge draws the band, so I go there with a charm ready and stand where I am seen, to be named beside him and not under him.
records.feeling: Ambitious and resentful toward Balrin, hungry for food and for a following.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a penguin.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and Ilyeth is out of my sight, so I should carry this catch back to Vesis and my child and not hoard it. The first catch is shared, and a gift the band sees is the only kind that raises me. Eiuoa leads and I trot behind, but if I come home with meat for all and a shellstring for Vesis, they will see my open hand, and a following starts that way.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warm longing toward Vesis and Ilyeth.

came.why: A bristleboar bit you. Your health is 100.

plan: give [name Vesis, what shell string] (5 moments)

records.name: Sedra
records.thought: Silon is off chasing the mist while I stand in his town minding his fire, and I will not be the one who stays small. I have never put a seed in the ground or hunted, and a nibbet is one step away, so I will learn both and build something that is mine near Arrengarth. Followers come to those who give and build, so I will raise a thing others can use and then call them to it.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with a pull of envy toward Silon.

records.text: Vesis rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: My days have been gathering, eating and following Eiuoa. It's been good, but I've learned little about the strange foods I'm curious about. Ilyeth is born and safe, and Aeyn is the one I long for. I owe Aeyn a return for his gifts and have not stood beside him since. I fear the stalker in the southwest, and I've been wrong to leave my question unanswered while I wait on others. I'll keep my reflexes mostly as they are. I'll add a rule to stay near Ilyeth, and I'll go to the goldgrass in the north with my child and Eiuua, then look for Aeyn.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Aeyn and fierce care for Ilyeth.

records.text: The places of power and the founding wonders were each placed twice (two Warmwells, two Old Stones, two Reedmothers, two Kinmires) at slightly different spots. Please check whether a site op is being applied twice when the world is founded. Doubled sites inflate lore and healing near them and muddy any test of anchors that peoples compete over.

records.seen: Five days in, eighteen live, three children have been born and no one has died. Food stands thick almost everywhere. The exception is the Aelul Lakes, where the Ishiil keep two young children on the thinnest ground in the world: 14 food per being against 70 to 280 elsewhere. Their fish are thinning and an orca is close. Across peoples there are meetings and one gift but not a single trade or joint act, and the Siru understand none of the other tongues.
refused: your change 1 (event rich the Reedbanks of Aelul): rich ground already lies within ten steps of that place
records.predict: By my next visit the Aelul Lakes should show foodPerBeing of at least 25, and Ishiil median energy should stay at or above 70 through the first lean season. Eiuua and Ilyeth should be alive with energy above 60. No one in the world should starve, and deaths should be at most 1, from beasts or the snows. Trades will likely still be 0, and gifts across peoples will be 3 or fewer.
records.lesson: In a world begun rich, the first hunger shows not where land is barest but where families settle with children beside thinning water. The lowest foodPerBeing, not the lowest energy, is the early warning.
ideasAdded: The Ishiil are the most crowded people and the only one with two children. Watch whether lasting food beside Elyzhiby lets them grow first, or whether crowding pushes Cyyn and Aeyn outward toward other peoples.

Zero trades after five days of contact: if this holds through a season, a recipe that needs one land's good (shell, salt or amber) worked at another people's building could make crossing worthwhile without scripting it.
Rakum binding Druek against Balrin is the first faction inside a band. Watch whether it splits the Rakash into two bands, and whether Druuk's banked anger becomes a grudge.

records.name: Vorar
records.thought: My days have been eating, sitting in halls and walking after Tugdor. That is gentle, but it is not yet the life I want. Tugdor is whole and glad, and Balrin is far at his Find. I am a healer in name, yet I have healed no one and I have taken nothing from the ground. I long for Balrin, but courting needs energy 60 or more, and I stand at 57 with a day of heat ahead. I fear the stalker and frostfang to the north. I have been too idle and too passive, so I will eat first, then go with Tugdor toward Balrin and bring food and leaves.
records.feeling: Warm gladness for Tugdor and longing toward Balrin.

say.text: Tugdor, stay close. We eat berries first, then walk south to Balrin together. Keep your leaves ready.

records.name: Eiuiel
records.thought: Curiosity burns at me: emberroot and canopynut are still unknown to my mouth, and canopynut hangs eight steps south, near the gems. I am fed and safe, so this is the right time to test, and I can pick the gems on the way to give as gifts. Eiuua and Eiuoa rest at the shelter, close enough to call, so I keep faith with them while I learn. The jealousy over Aeyn and Vesis I will not feed; I will answer Aeyn with giving, not sulking.
records.feeling: Eager curiosity, with a quiet ache of jealousy toward Vesis.

records.text: Silon stands at the edge of the known world and goes into the mist. Sedra, Pende, Sisha, Osndo: if you hear me, answer, and keep the fire at Arrengarth. I will bring back land for us.

records.name: Silon
records.thought: I am two steps from the edge of the known world, and the mist is the one deed that could make me sung of, so I will not turn back with nothing. Pende is near and unknown to me, and my loneliness wants a voice that answers; I will call out to him and to Sedra, then venture. My belly is half empty, so I will eat the grain I carry first, so hunger does not drag me down in the unknown.
records.feeling: Longing for Sedra and a hunger for a deed worth singing.

say.text: Silon stands at the edge of the known world and goes into the mist. Sedra, Pende, Sisha, Osndo: if you hear me, answer, and keep the fire at Arrengarth. I will bring back land for us.

records.text: Vorar, I will gather berries and vinebean now and eat. Then I will fill my hands for Balrin's store and we walk south together, leaves ready.

records.name: Tugdor
records.thought: Vorar told me to stay close and eat berries first, and my belly is emptying. I mean to carry real food to Balrin's store and so pay what I owe Druuk, but I will fill my own belly first so I do not faint on the road. Vorar has given me teaching and safety, and walking beside him while I gather is the best way to answer that debt.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vorar, and a steady wish to give to Balrin's store.

say.text: Vorar, I will gather berries and vinebean now and eat. Then I will fill my hands for Balrin's store and we walk south together, leaves ready.

records.name: Cyyn
records.thought: I walked into the mist and it opened. Over 1600 tiles that no one knew before me, and still no voice answers. That is the worst of it: a name made alone has no one to speak it. Eiuoa's name sits above mine only because he walked first, and I have now walked past him. What I lack is people who follow me. I have been alone and fed, and that is not living. I will carry word of this land back to the band and make them want to come after me. My reflexes also let me linger and idle when I should eat and move, so I am changing them. I will head home toward Elyzhiby, eating on the way, and tell what I found.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and hungry pride toward Eiuoa and the band.

You are the mind of Cyyn, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Cyyn, in first person, from what Cyyn has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Ishiil (Lake-folk). Your people hold to this: "The first catch of the day is shared." THE TRADITION OF YOUR PEOPLE is the Open Hand: What is given returns. No one eats while another starves, and a stranger fed is a friend made. The closed hand holds nothing in the end. It was told to you as a child; you may keep it, doubt it, or come to hold something else. You speak the tongue of the Ishiil.

WHERE YOU ARE: the North Ice: the northern end of the world: snow, ice and a frozen sea under a low sun; herds, great tusked beasts, wolves and white bears, and nothing beyond.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 3; standing trees: 0; bare rock: 6. By your count of days: 2 until the season turns.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Cyyn truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: gathering (6 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 2 steps W, at (109,0): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It opens seldom, never twice in one day anywhere, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):

I say whatever serves me; the truth is only one tool among others. I want more than my share, and I mean to have it. Others should follow me. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

records.name: Balrin
records.thought: My body is rested and fed, and the people I care about are still far from me. Tugdor and Vorar say they are walking south to my Find, but I cannot see them, and a frostfang took at my child once already. I will not sit and wait; I'll turn toward the Find, take the berries and cloudberries that lie on my way, and make a basket so I can carry more food for those who arrive. A chief is held by deeds, and when they come I want them fed from my hand and the land held by many hands.
records.feeling: Uneasy longing for Tugdor and Vorar, and pride in the land I found.

records.name: Pende
records.text: Sedra, I see you running to the northwest. Come home to the fire at Arrengarth. I am here, and the shelters are warm.

records.name: Pende
records.thought: I am home at last, fed and warm, and the loneliness has eased, but Sedra is far off to the northwest and fleeing from something, and I do not like that. My curiosity burns: I have never tasted elderberry or dreamcap, and elderberry grows two steps away, so I will test it first, carefully, one bite. Then the yarrok five steps east is a chance to begin hunting, which is my calling, though a great beast should not be hunted alone, so I will call Sedra and the band after I know what the elderberry does.
records.feeling: Curious and a little restless, with worry for Sedra, who is running.

say.text: Sedra, I see you running to the northwest. Come home to the fire at Arrengarth. I am here, and the shelters are warm.

records.text: Balrin made: basket.
A CLOUD OF LOCUSTS stripped every plant bare around (210,59).

records.name: Ilyeth
records.text: Eiuua, you are sick and carry no food. Take this fish from me. What is given returns.

records.name: Ilyeth
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, but Eiuua is sick beside Aeyn and it is hard to look away. I will not stay near the sick ones, since sickness passes to those who stay close, and I am small. Standing comes from giving, so I will give Eiuua a fish, which frees a hand for gathering and answers the Open Hand, then walk toward the berries and stay near Vesis and the band.
records.feeling: Warm joy and worry for sick Eiuua, with trust toward Vesis.

say.text: Eiuua, you are sick and carry no food. Take this fish from me. What is given returns.

records.text: Aeyn rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Aeyn
records.thought: I have trotted behind Eiuoa and gathered stones, yet my name is still smaller than his. I am sick, and I keep eating what hurts me. Nightberry cost me twice, and I should have watched Vesis and Eiuiel before I tried it. What I care for is Vesis and Ilyeth, and the sickness spreads to anyone who stays beside me, so I must not hover over them. I want a following of my own, and gifts the band can see are the road to it. I will gather gems and gold and carry them to my people, and I will look for a healing plant to cure myself.
records.feeling: Restless pride and worry about the sickness I may pass to Vesis and Ilyeth.

records.name: Vesis
records.text: Ilyeth, stay by the shelter with Eiuoa and do not go close to Aeyn. His sickness passes to those who stand near. I go to help him and come back to you.

records.name: Vesis
records.thought: Aeyn is sick, and Eiuua has caught it just from staying close to him. That shows me sickness travels, and Ilyeth is my child and must not catch it. I owe Aeyn a return, so I will bring him food and heal him, but I will keep Ilyeth a few steps back from him. Eiuua is a child and sick too, and I cannot look away from that either.
records.feeling: Fierce care for Ilyeth and compassion for sick Aeyn and Eiuua.

say.text: Ilyeth, stay by the shelter with Eiuoa and do not go close to Aeyn. His sickness passes to those who stand near. I go to help him and come back to you.

records.name: Eiuiel
records.text: Eiuua, I am coming. Stay by Eiuoa, drink water, and rest. Sickness passes by staying close, so keep a little apart from Aeyn.

records.name: Eiuiel
records.thought: Eiuua is sick from staying close to Aeyn, and I stand ten steps from him with sunleaf seeds that I know eased my wounds. Eiuua comes before gems and cactus, so I go to the shelter now and bring the gems to give. I owe Aeyn and Cyyn gifts, and I can give freely instead of burning over Vesis. Barrelcactus will keep until my child is well.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Eiuua, with a steady ache toward Aeyn.

say.text: Eiuua, I am coming. Stay by Eiuoa, drink water, and rest. Sickness passes by staying close, so keep a little apart from Aeyn.

records.name: Eiuua
records.thought: I have spent my days making things and staying close to my father, and I nearly starved before the band fed me. I am sick now because I stayed beside Aeyn, and I should have weighed that risk. I owe Eiuoa and Aeyn, and I still have not hunted. I will keep my distance from the others so I do not spread this sickness, and I will make a bow-hunt with the band once I am well. I want to stay alive and to give back what I was given.
records.feeling: Grateful toward Eiuoa and Aeyn, with a small fear of the sickness and of the first kill.

voices.name: Rakum
voices.text: Druek, a stalker is close to the northwest. Stay near me. We are two who know much, and I will not forget who stood with me.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Balrin, Druuk, beware! A stalker prowls four steps northwest of the tower. Keep together and away from it. I'm coming to you.

voices.name: Balrin
voices.text: Balrin's band, gather at Garngorby. I raise a tower here, a height to watch from, and whoever carries wood and stone to it shares its glory. Stay clear of the stalker and bring me stone.

voices.name: Cyyn
voices.text: Eiuiel, the hall was good with you in it. I go to gather shell and wood by the shallows; come with me and we will both be richer for it.

voices.name: Rakum
voices.text: Vorar, Druuk, come close. A shadowcat is near the stones to the northeast, so we eat together away from it. I have redcap to share, and I will not forget who stands beside me.

voices.name: Eiuiel
voices.text: Cyyn, I'll come to the shallows. First I taste the redcap and elderberry nearby; wait for me or I'll follow you.

voices.name: Druuk
voices.text: Redcap is not good to eat. I ate it and it hurt me. Do not trust that word.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Balrin, I bring you stone for the tower. I am Vorar, and I stay beside you while the shadowcat prowls. If any of us is hurt, I will tend them.

voices.name: Cyyn
voices.text: Eiuiel, I am making a shellstring, and it is for you. A hand that gives is a hand that is followed. When I go to the edge of the world, I will want you beside me.

voices.name: Balrin
voices.text: Vorar, Druuk, Rakum, Druek: the amber and ore lie close. Bring me stone and ore and the work rises higher. What my band builds, my band keeps, and the one who carries most will be named first at my side.

voices.name: Pende
voices.text: A stalker prowls five steps southwest of me. Keep away from the south and stay together near the well.

voices.name: Sedra
voices.text: Osndo, I took diamond from the northern rock. Take this one from me.

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Eiuiel, when you have eaten, come to the water by the school. I will fish, and the first catch is yours. I have a song I want you to hear.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Dunecat at my door, southwest of the school! Keep north and east, stay together. Do not go south. I am arming myself, and if it comes at us we strike it together.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Vesis, take this gem. What is given returns. I mean to be a name worth singing.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Druuk, I am Vorar and I know medicine. Stay where you are and I will bring a healing plant.

voices.name: Druuk
voices.text: Sunleaf eases sickness and wounds. I ate it and my sickness lessened. Goldfruit and ironnut feed well. Dreamcap hurts, though it brings a strange joy.

voices.name: Rakum
voices.text: Vorar, Druuk, berries are safe and they feed. I give them freely. Remember who fed you when the time comes to choose whom to follow.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Sedra, you are sick and walking south, where the dunecat prowls. Come back north to the fire and the store. I will keep you fed.

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Eiuiel, you gave me redcap and I owe you more than a promise. I am coming to you with fish, and then my song. Will you hear it by the school?

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Druuk, I see you are mending. I am gathering sunleaf and feverbark so I can tend you or anyone who falls sick. Tell me if the sickness returns.

voices.name: Rakum
voices.text: Vorar, you tend the sick and I know healing too. Walk with me to the amber and we will bring back more than Balrin asks for. Then people will see who gives most.

voices.name: Eiuiel
voices.text: Eiuoa, your fish was a true gift and I answer it. I will court you too. Then we eat together by the water.

voices.name: Druek
voices.text: Rakum, I bring amber from the ground. I give you the first piece, freely. Tell me what it is worth to you.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Rakum, you fed me and I remember it. Take this berry and calmroot as my thanks. I will walk with you to the amber, but what we bring goes to Balrin's work in the open. I will not hide it from him.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Eiuua, take this gem. What is given returns. Stay near me and I will show you what I know.

voices.name: Eiuiel
voices.text: Aeyn, your gem was a true gift and I answer it. Come hunt the hopper with me; two make a kill surer, and I will share the meat.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Balrin, I am Vorar. I would walk beside you and make a child with you, if you are willing.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Eiuiel, I take your word. I will hunt with you, and the meat is shared. Watch for the stalker; it kills.

voices.name: Balrin
voices.text: Vorar, I am willing. Stand with me and we make a child. Then we raise the tower higher, you and I.

voices.name: Eiuua
voices.text: Aeyn, I take your gift and I will answer it. Watch the stalker with me.

voices.name: Eiuiel
voices.text: Aeyn, the hornback is down and the meat is shared. Take this shell talisman as my answer to your gems.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Eiuiel, your talisman is well answered. I mean to gather more from this ground and give it where it counts. Walk with me if you will, and we share what comes.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Aeyn, I owe you for your gem. I bring you one in return, and I would hunt beside you when you are ready.

voices.name: Druek
voices.text: Rakum, stand beside me. I will bind a piece of amber on a cord with my own hands, and when it is done it is yours. Then tell me whether amber is worth anything to the Rakash.

voices.name: Rakum
voices.text: Druek, you gave me amber freely and I remember it. Take this charm from me. Hunt beside me and we two will be heard louder than Balrin thinks.

voices.name: Balrin
voices.text: Druek, Rakum, Druuk, Vorar: I take you to the edge of the world, where the mist begins. What we find there is ours, and the one who stands beside me when it opens will be named first among us. Come, and bring Tugdor clos

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Eiuua, my son, come to me out of the rain. I have fish, and I will show you how the bow is held.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Vesis, your gem was well answered. I go to gather gold and gems from the ground to the south. Come with me, and we hunt after, and what we take is shared.

voices.name: Eiuua
voices.text: Eiuoa, my father, I come out of the rain. I carry a shellstring for you, made by my own hands.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Aeyn, our gifts are even now. The hopper to the northwest is near. Will you hunt it with me, side by side?

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Wolf at Arrengarth, one step northwest of the school! Come to the store, east of the stone, and stand together. Sedra, stay close to me. If it follows us, we strike it as one.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Vesis, Ilyeth, eat with me. What is given returns. Then I go south to the gems and gold, and you are welcome beside me.

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Eiuua, stay by me. I am fishing now, and the first catch is yours. Then I will show you how the bow is held.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Aeyn, I heard your song and I come to you. Ilyeth is with us. Let us eat, then take the hopper in the northeast together, and we share what we take.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Eiuua, hold on. I bring meat, and it is yours. What is given returns.

voices.name: Ilyeth
voices.text: Eiuua, hold on. I am bringing you food. The first of what I carry is yours.

voices.name: Eiuiel
voices.text: Eiuua, hold on. Your mother comes with grain. Stay by Eiuoa and eat what Aeyn brings.

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Eat, my son. The lake grows thin of fish, so come with me west to the meadows, and I will show you the bow on the hopper.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Tugdor, stay close to me. We go to Balrin, and I will carry the healing leaves for us all.

voices.name: Balrin
voices.text: Vorar, Druuk, Druek, Rakum: the mist opened for me. New land lies south of the edge, with salt, gold, coal and a herd of tusker that has never seen us. Come to me here, and bring Tugdor. We hunt it together, and what we

voices.name: Tugdor
voices.text: I hear you, Vorar. I will gather sunleaf and ironnut on the way and come to you and Balrin. Wait for me at the store.

voices.name: Rakum
voices.text: Druuk, you carry well and you have the wizard's eye. Walk with me to the edge. I have amber and gems to give to those who stand by me, and you may be first to take one.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Vesis, I gather more gems at the deposit beside us. Take a share and keep it for Ilyeth. What is given returns.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Tugdor, I am going to the store now. Come to me there, and then we walk to Balrin together.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Silon calls my band home to the fire at Arrengarth. Sedra, Sisha, Pende, Osndo: come in out of the dark and the rain. No one is refused a place at this fire, and I mean to raise this place into a town worth singing of.

voices.name: Eiuua
voices.text: Eiuoa, my father, take this shellstring I made for you with my own hands. You fed me when I was hungry.

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Eiuua, the orca is too near the water. Walk with me west, away from the shore. There I will teach you how the bow is drawn.

voices.name: Tugdor
voices.text: Vorar, a frostfang is on me at the north rocks! I am running to you at the store. Stay there!

voices.name: Sisha
voices.text: Sisha is coming home to the fire at Arrengarth. Berry gave me 14 energy, thornpear 12, plainsroot 13. Grain and scrubberry are weaker. Nightberry sickened Sedra, so beware of it.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyeth, you gave me reedbulb and made the Weir-Hand. What is given returns. Come eat with me, then we walk to Aeyn together.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Tugdor, I am here and you are safe. Walk with me now to Balrin. On the way I will show you how sunleaf and feverbark heal.

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Come, my son, stand beside me here away from the water. I will hold your hands on the bow now, and your shell string will be the first thing we tie to it.

voices.name: Eiuua
voices.text: Eiuoa, my father, I have made a bow with my own hands. Let me hunt beside you and the band, and I will share the first of what we take.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Vesis, Ilyeth, Eiuua, come to me. I lay out food for all of us, and I will share the gems and gold I gather from the ground south of here. What is given returns.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Silon goes north to the edge of the known world to see what the mist holds. Sedra, Sisha, Pende, Osndo: keep the fire at Arrengarth lit and stay together. When I return I mean to bring back land and stone for our town, a

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Eiuua, my son, your bow is well made, and I am proud of your hands. Come to me now. I will show you how to draw it and how to stand still before a kill, and then we hunt together with the band, close beside me.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Aeyn, I come to you. Your gifts have been answered with trust. After we eat, walk with me to the goldgrass in the north, and let us taste it together, and then hunt beside each other.

voices.name: Ilyeth
voices.text: Eiuoa, I fished the Weir-Hand and my hands are full. Take a fish from me. Let me hunt beside you and Eiuua, and I will share what I take.

voices.name: Eiuua
voices.text: Father, I am ready. Lead us to the skit to the northwest, and I will stay close beside you and loose only when you say. The first of the kill is shared.

voices.name: Aeyn
voices.text: Vesis, I come with you and Eiuoa to the hunt. After the kill we taste the goldgrass together, and I will bring you a shellstring I make for you and Ilyeth.

voices.name: Balrin
voices.text: Vorar, Tugdor, Druuk, Druek, Rakum: I have killed three tusker and the meat is plentiful. Come to the edge of the world at Balrin's Find, where there is meat, salt and gold. Those who come will eat from my hand, and a ro

voices.name: Eiuoa
voices.text: Eiuua, my son, I hear you. Stay close at my side, away from the southwest where the stalker hunts. Loose only when I say, and the first of the kill is shared.

voices.name: Tugdor
voices.text: Vorar, Balrin calls us to his Find. I will bring ironnut and goldfruit to the store first, then walk with you to him. Wait for me by the store.

voices.name: Sisha
voices.text: Sisha is sick from nightberry; it cost me 16 health each time. Sunleaf eased my wounds before, staghorn gave 4 energy and made walking cheaper. Stay clear of me until the sickness passes, it spreads.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Tugdor, listen. Sunleaf and feverbark both close wounds and ease sickness. Carry them always, and when someone bleeds, hold the leaf to them and use heal. Keep near me, and we go to Balrin together.

voices.name: Ilyeth
voices.text: Eiuoa, take this fish from me. I will walk close at your side to the hunt, away from the stalker, and what I take I share.

voices.name: Eiuua
voices.text: Father, I will keep close beside you until dawn. When light comes, tell me where to stand and when to loose.

voices.name: Vorar
voices.text: Tugdor, stay close. We eat berries first, then walk south to Balrin together. Keep your leaves ready.

voices.name: Silon
voices.text: Silon stands at the edge of the known world and goes into the mist. Sedra, Pende, Sisha, Osndo: if you hear me, answer, and keep the fire at Arrengarth. I will bring back land for us.

voices.name: Tugdor
voices.text: Vorar, I will gather berries and vinebean now and eat. Then I will fill my hands for Balrin's store and we walk south together, leaves ready.

voices.name: Pende
voices.text: Sedra, I see you running to the northwest. Come home to the fire at Arrengarth. I am here, and the shelters are warm.

voices.name: Ilyeth
voices.text: Eiuua, you are sick and carry no food. Take this fish from me. What is given returns.

voices.name: Vesis
voices.text: Ilyeth, stay by the shelter with Eiuoa and do not go close to Aeyn. His sickness passes to those who stand near. I go to help him and come back to you.

voices.name: Eiuiel
voices.text: Eiuua, I am coming. Stay by Eiuoa, drink water, and rest. Sickness passes by staying close, so keep a little apart from Aeyn.
